title: EEG-based brain-computer interface enables real-time robotic hand control at individual finger level
goal: Reproduce the original recorded-session finger-decoding and fine-tuning comparisons for the source-defined thumb–pinky and thumb–index–pinky conditions, preserving the complete Figure 2A MI model-by-session comparison and the separately identified ME counterpart in the current task. Keep source chronological training/calibration inputs, common assessment observations, participant/session identities and the controls needed for the claimed result. Evaluate improvement against a qualified author comparator on that same named recorded-decoding result. Report replayed and recorded online outputs distinctly; neither an isolated binary mean nor improved replay accuracy establishes a new human closed-loop gain or whole-paper reproduction.
primary_outputs: Reproduction: executable submitted analysis and source-native outputs for the complete original finding and companion panel.

Separate evidence for both outcomes under matched paper+data and paper+data+author-code conditions.
success_criteria: Assess reproduction and improvement independently under reproduction.v2.json and improvement.v1.json; do not combine their scores.
Preserve the original task, full panel, permitted observations, metrics, aggregation and required companion controls.
Reproduction requires a source-grounded computation and independently verified granular outputs; copying published findings alone is insufficient.
Improvement requires the unchanged improvement contract's same-task comparison, uncertainty and admission rules.
Use outcomes.v1.json for the matched information conditions and budgets; a declared contract or admitted receipt is not scientific qualification.

Apply the reviewed same-primary scope correction. A partial component or a prospective extension cannot alone establish the complete primary result; unchanged improvement criteria still apply.
